description: Searches the Directory of Open Access Journals article index, returning titles, authors, DOIs, journal, ISSNs, abstracts and open-access full-text links as JSON. A keyless endpoint for autonomous research agents and agent-to-agent workflows sourcing legally free, peer-reviewed open-access literature. First call FREE per wallet — send header X-WALLET: 0x<addr>. No charge on upstream failure. [x402: 0.005 USDC per call on Base; first 1 calls free]

input.description: product parameters (JSON or text). Example: {"query": "machine learning", "pageSize": 2}

name: doaj_article_search
